LiveLife is a network of community pharmacies that is united in a shared vision to make a difference in the lives of our customers.

www.livelifepharmacy.com

We have pharmacies in great locations such as …Noosa, Sunshine Coast, Greater Brisbane, Whitsundays, Yeppoon, Port Douglas, Agnes Water, Mission Beach, and more…

The Opportunity
An exciting opportunity for a clinically focused community Pharmacist, who is committed to patient counselling, to join a busy retail Pharmacy Group.
We are looking for a full-time candidate, with experienced pharmacists welcome to apply for the position.
Remuneration will be based on your experience and qualifications.
$76,515 per year exclusive of superannuation.

The Location
LiveLife Airlie Beach 7 Day Pharmacy - 366 Shute Harbour Road, Airlie Beach Qld

A Day in the Life of a LiveLife Pharmacist
* Proactively engaging, advising, and enriching the lives of our customers and patients.
* Using your clinical knowledge, skills, and experience to provide optimal healthcare solutions.
* Actively implementing PPI programs and forward dispensing services.
* Being an active and motivating member of the pharmacy team.
* Working with other pharmacists and an intern.
* DAA (webster pack) checking

Required skills and experience
We are looking for a person who loves to laugh, smile and enjoy their day, as well as encourage and inspire those around them. To be successful in this role you will need to be an AHPRA registered Pharmacist, and demonstrate the following:

* AHPRA registration
* Have at least two years of experience for the role
* Self-motivation and eagerness to join a vibrant team environment.
* Willingness to go the extra mile with a desire to counsel patients with your up-to-date pharmaceutical and clinical knowledge.
* Enjoying getting to know patients on a personal level, providing them with tailored input to help them with their health concerns, needs, and goals.
* Ability to clearly communicate and demonstrate a solid understanding of medication management.
* Immunisation/vaccination preferred, however, not essential.

$76,515 per year exclusive of superannuation.
$45 to $50 per hour exclusive of superannuation.

We operate 7 days per week so your roster may include weekend shifts.

result.description: AGILE ENERGY PTY LTD   Position Summary   Agile Energy is seeking an experienced Electrician – Solar & Battery Site Specialist to conduct site inspections, technical assessments, and support the delivery of commercial and industrial solar and battery storage projects across Australia. The role is responsible for assessing customer sites, identifying technical requirements, validating project feasibility and providing accurate information to support engineering, sales and project delivery teams   Key Responsibilities    Conduct site inspections for commercial and industrial solar and battery projects.  Complete detailed site assessment reports including photographs, measurements and technical observations.  Assess existing electrical infrastructure, switchboards, transformers and distribution networks.  Identify installation constraints, safety risks and compliance requirements.  Verify customer energy infrastructure and meter configurations.  Review roof conditions, structural considerations and cable pathways.  Confirm available switchboard capacity and connection requirements.  Identify opportunities for battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and energy efficiency upgrades.  Liaise directly with customers, facility managers, site managers and contractors during inspections.  Support engineering teams with the technical information required for system design.  Assist with commissioning, troubleshooting and defect resolution when required.  Ensure all works comply with relevant Australian Standards, electrical regulations and workplace safety requirements  Maintain accurate records, reports and project documentation.    Skills & Experience    Current Electrical Licence.  CEC Accredited Installer (preferred).  Minimum 3 years' experience in commercial solar installations.  Strong understanding of commercial switchboards, metering and electrical distribution systems  Experience with battery storage systems and grid connections.  Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and single-line diagrams.  Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and customer-facing abilities.  Proficient in Microsoft Office and mobile reporting applications.  Current driver's licence.  Working at Heights, EWP and First Aid certifications (preferred).    Key Performance Indicators    Site inspections completed on time.  Quality and accuracy of site assessment reports.  Reduction in design variations and installation issues.  Compliance with safety and quality standards.  Support provided to sales and engineering teams.  Customer satisfaction and responsiveness.    What Success Looks Like    Accurate site assessments completed first time.  Projects designed correctly with minimal rework.  Technical risks identified before project commencement.  Strong support provided to sales, engineering and delivery teams.  Positive customer experience throughout the pre-construction process.   About Company    Agile Energy is a distributed energy generation company specialising in building and operating solar assets across Australia and New Zealand. We are revolutionising energy solutions by offering low-cost, low-carbon, and low-risk renewable power tailored to businesses, industries, and governments. We manage all project stages from origination through deployment and operations with leading partners in the Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Investment Sectors. Our Build-Own-Operate model allows businesses to access the environmental and financial benefits of solar without the up-front material costs.
